system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
- Applicable provision: Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, which sets the statutory interest rate when no other rate is specified by law or agreement.
- Last set: By Royal Decree Prescribing the Interest Rate under Section 7 of the Civil and Commercial Code, B.E. 2567 (2024), effective 11 April 2024.
- Current rate: 5% per annum.
- I am not aware of any adjustment after that date.
